scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw DFT outputs is infeasible because only the final CSV is submitted; we use structural ordering and result-level comparisons with paper-reported gold values and generous tolerances.

outputs.description: Scored file: the checker verifies the Eg ordering trend matches the paper's exact ranking, all phi_deg fall within 130–160°, d_BL for 3,6-MMCB-SDP is near 1.54 Å while others are near 1.48 Å, and all EB are positive and within tolerance of reference values.

output_contract.notes: The agent must run the full DFT and TD-DFT pipeline; the CSV is the sole scored artifact. The checker uses structural checks (ordering, range, anomaly) combined with value tolerances against paper-reported E_g and E_B references.

steps.description: Check Eg ordering per phase exactly matches paper trend (OCP≈BCO < SDP < SCP < TCP < TDP < BCS < BCT). Partial credit based on fraction of satisfied pairwise constraints.
Each Eg value within 0.15 eV of paper-reported gold. Score = fraction of rows meeting tolerance.
All phi_deg values between 130 and 160 degrees inclusive. Score = fraction of rows in range.
d_BL_A for 3,6-MMCB-SDP in [1.52,1.56] Å, all others in [1.46,1.50] Å. Score = fraction of rows satisfying.
Each EB value within 0.5 eV of paper-reported gold. Score = fraction of rows meeting tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold Eg and EB values for each monomer/phase
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 3 and Table 4 of the paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: direct transcription of paper-reported values from tables
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact reported numbers; values are verification targets that the reference solve.sh also reproduces.
